name: Crate Dock
author: ZadenZ
description: Warehouse sorting on Vita. Sort the crate stream into the right bins to clear 10 levels and Endless quotas, then solve Rack Jam sliding-rack puzzles: 12 levels with star ratings plus an endless mode. Native Vita port of the Save Point arcade game, with the full scene and touch controls on one screen.
requirements: Requires libshacccg.suprx: install ShaRKBR33D once (from VitaDB Downloader) before first launch, then install the vpk with VitaShell.
